name: Frozen decision-score closure check
purpose: Replace the original SVDD alpha ranking with decision-score ranking on exactly the same 36 custom needle cases. This is a post-pilot diagnostic, not held-out validation.

svdd.bandwidth: unchanged per-head sampled median positive squared distance
svdd.score_interpretation: signed squared feature-space distance beyond the fitted block sphere radius; higher retains more outlying keys
svdd.normalization_reason: raw OneClassSVM dual mass is nu times block length; dividing by that mass removes this implementation scale, including for the final partial block
svdd.ranking: one global per-head ranking of every token's block-relative score; no per-block retention quotas, percentile transforms, or z-scores
svdd.free_support_ties: Free support vectors can still share the fitted boundary score within solver tolerance; no noise or tie tuning is added.

unchanged: all prefix and question token IDs
four sinks and 32 recent positions inside each budget
baseline_policy: Rerun full cache, KeyDiff, and leverage contemporaneously; compare their scores and answers with the original pilot. Original alpha results remain separately archived and are joined only by exact case IDs and prefix hashes.
decision_rule: Close the KV-compression direction if decision ranking loses to or matches the geometric baselines. These reused cases cannot establish a held-out win; no additional tuning or new benchmark campaign is part of this check.
reporting: Report every budget, length and task, paired differences, solver convergence, actual compacted KV bytes, and measured selection costs. Do not pool these answers with the original 1350-answer pilot or advertise shared-harness timing as isolated serving performance.
